cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, time, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
import pipeline
img=json.load(open('/app/examples/sample.image.json'))
big={'op':'lookup','image':img,'addresses':['2001:db8::%x'%i for i in range(20000)]}
data=json.dumps(big).encode()
print('size', len(data))
def nohook(b): return json.loads(b)
def withhook(b): return json.loads(b, object_pairs_hook=pipeline._no_duplicate_keys, parse_constant=pipeline._reject_constant, parse_float=pipeline._check_float)
t=time.time(); nohook(data); print('no hook %.3f' % (time.time()-t))
t=time.time(); withhook(data); print('hook %.3f' % (time.time()-t))
EOF
